data.name: Amalesh
data.gender_notes: Amalesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Amalesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the combination of two words: 'Ama' meaning 'Lord' and 'Resh' meaning 'World'. This name signifies the one who rules over the entire universe. It is a powerful and auspicious name often given to boys in Hindu traditions. The name Amalesh carries the meaning “Lord of the World” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amalesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the world and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who holds the universe in his hands.
data.etymology: Amalesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the World.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amalesh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Amalesh is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and culture. It is a name that signifies power, authority, and rule. In Hindu traditions, the concept of a deity ruling over the universe is deeply engrained. The name is a reminder of the divine presence that governs all aspects of life. It is a name that instills a sense of reverence and respect, encouraging individuals to strive for excellence and leadership qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Amalesh represents the supreme consciousness that pervades the universe. It serves as a reminder of our connection to the divine and the importance of surrendering our egos to the higher power. The name also symbolizes the inner strength and courage required to navigate the challenges of life and fulfill our dharma or purpose. Ultimately, it is a name that inspires individuals to seek inner peace, wisdom, and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Amalesh: The relentless pursuit of Dharma (righteous duty) in the face of adversity. The unwavering warrior spirit against the forces of ignorance and evil.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Amalesh is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a name of the god Vishnu. The name Amalesh carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
